relevance_note: A basic-science study of a 34-patient HA20 cohort that gives patient-level genetic detail for a few named patients, e.g. patient HA20-14's "germline TNFAIP3 c.503G > A (p.Trp168*) mutation".
method_note: Worked by reading the full Markdown by hand; the output JSON was assembled with a short Python script in the scratch directory from values I transcribed, then spans were checked verbatim by script. The paper has no patient table in the Markdown: per-patient data for the 34-patient cohort (19 in six families) are in supplementary table S1, which is not included, so only patients named in the text get rows (HA20-1, HA20-14, HA20-15, HA20-21). CONTRADICTION: the Results and Methods name the two scRNA-seq patients as 'HA20-1 and HA20-21' (7691 cells), but the Fig. 6C legend gives 'HA20-1: 1454 cells; HA20-34: 6237 cells' (sum 7691); I recorded one person labelled HA20-21 and did not create a separate HA20-34 row. SOMATIC VARIANTS: for HA20-14 only c.503G > A (p.Trp168*) is stated as germline; the TNFAIP3 c.1880_1881delGT (p.Cys627fs) and MYD88 c.617C > G (p.Ser206Cys) rows are acquired 'second genetic hits' found in lymphoma tissue, not germline (the schema has no somatic field; context is given in their second span). HA20-1 has no variant row because the text gives no variant description for that patient, only 'germline TNFAIP3 mutations'; the patient's A20 deficiency/constitutive NF-κB activation (immunoblot, Fig. 3A) is recorded as a phenotypic feature. Zygosity left 'not reported' for every variant: heterozygosity is stated only for HA20 or the cohort in general ('heterozygous TNFAIP3 loss'), not for a named patient (rule 8). No variant class is named in words, so variant_type is 'not reported' except the chromosomal deletion. No transcript is stated for HA20 variants (NM_006290.4 is given only for a somatic MF/SS variant). Re-reports: the Methods say 'Functional information of already published TNFAIP3 mutations from HA20 families can be obtained from the Infevers database (56)', which hints that some cohort families were published before but does not say so explicitly; cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null. All checklist items are 'not reported': lymphoma (HA20-14, HA20-15) was not mapped to 'lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy', and HA20-1's cytokine elevation was not mapped to 'elevated inflammatory markers (CRP/ESR)'. Not given rows: healthy donors, the ABC DLBCL and MF/SS lymphoma cohorts and the DLBCL case with somatic A20 deficiency (none has HA20). Other internal inconsistency, not about HA20 patients: the ABC DLBCL cohort is n = 68 (Fig. 1E legend), '21 of 66' (text) and 51 patients (Methods).
